titulo: MILLIONAIRE SQUAD! Players +120 FAST! | OSM PRO

linhas.text: We all know that being rich in OSM is every manager's dream.
But the truth is, nobody wants to spend too many boss coins to achieve that goal.
Today, I'm going to share some valuable techniques that will allow you to evolve
your squad without emptying your pockets. If you follow each of these eight steps,
you will be able to build monstrous squads in all your leagues.
And as a bonus, the last two steps are special and saved just for you.
This video is an improved version of our greatest hit,
which has almost reached 300,000 views on the Portuguese channel.
So, whether you're here for the first time or a loyal follower, you're in the right place.
And the best part? This video will always be online so you don't need to take notes.
Just save it to your favorites to consult whenever you want.
Tip 1. Invest in youth.
The first tip is crucial. Have a young player for each position in your squad.
Why? Because young players have tremendous potential to evolve throughout the league.
When I say young, I mean players under 20 years old.
These are the players you will train relentlessly throughout the season,
ensuring that by the end, you have a squad full of talent.
To facilitate this process, if you have the possibility, use the scout.
With him, you can choose exactly the players you want and who fit your needs.
Tip 2. Keep the worst player.
The second tip might seem counterintuitive, but it's extremely effective.
Always keep the worst player in each position in your squad.
And why? Because in OSM, there's a maximum number of players you can have per position.
Three forwards, four midfielders, four defenders, and two goalkeepers.
By keeping the worst player in each sector,
you ensure that you can place the players you really want on sale
without being hindered by the minimum player limit.
This way, you won't block the sale of your best players when you most need to make a transfer.
Tip 3. Constant transactions.
The third tip is about the importance of buying and selling players continuously throughout the league.
This step might seem simple, but it is by far the most crucial of all.
Constant buying and selling is the most effective way to generate money in the game.
And the best part? Buying players on the transfer list costs only one boss coin.
Imagine the profit potential you can achieve by maximizing this strategy.
Tip 4. Selling strategy.
Selling players can be a challenge, but with these references, you'll find the process much simpler.
First, always be attentive to the values the simulator is paying for players in your league.
You shouldn't exceed these values too much to avoid making sales difficult.
As the league progresses, these values tend to increase,
meaning you will be able to sell increasingly better players.
List players for the maximum allowed value, up to 50 million.
If the value is higher, I suggest listing the player for about double their real value.
For example, if the player is worth 30 million, list him for 59 million.
Remember, more valuable players might take longer to sell.
If a player hasn't sold in two days, adjust the price or change your strategy.
Tip 5. Smart buying buying players also has its science.
Ideally, you should always buy when the value is less than 1.5 times the player's real value.
For example, if the player is worth 10 million, you should buy for less than 15 million.
If you have the possibility to use the scout even better, with him,
you are guaranteed to buy players at advantageous prices, as the purchase value through the scout
is always less than 1.5 times the player's real value.
This is an excellent way to ensure you make profitable deals
and strengthen your squad without spending too many resources.
Tip 6. Friendly matches for evolution.
Friendly matches are a powerful tool in OSL.
Each one costs four boss coins, but the investment is worth it.
I recommend playing at least two friendlies per day to maximize improvements.
The improvements players get are quite significant.
It's important to note that the more friendlies you play in the same day,
the smaller the improvement.
Therefore, two friendlies per day is the ideal number.
Moreover, the younger your players are, the more they will evolve with these matches.
Tip 7. Nationality bonus few people know,
but in OSM there is a nationality bonus that can make a considerable difference.
Whenever you have six players of the same nationality in your starting 11,
your team plays better.
This bonus, although never officially quantified,
is estimated to offer around a 2% advantage.
It's a small detail, but it can be decisive in balanced matches.
Tip 8. Age balance.
Finally, a bonus tip that is crucial for your team's success.
Maintain an age balance in your squad.
Avoid forming a team exclusively with young players or conversely with older players.
Ensure that in your starting 11, you have at least three players over 26 years old.
And don't forget, your captain must be over 30 years old.
This mix of youth and experience is essential for consistent and solid
performance throughout the season.
These were the eight tips, including two special bonuses,
that will take your OSM game to another level.
If you learned something new and liked the tips, don't forget to like the video,
share it with your friends, and subscribe to the channel.
This way, you won't miss any of the upcoming content that will continue to help you be the
best manager in OSM. Stay tuned and see you next time!
